title: npm registry configured over cleartext
description: .npmrc declares a `registry` URL over cleartext. An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `registry` URL over cleartext.
remediation: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a `registry` URL over cleartext.
limitation: It matches a `registry` URL over cleartext in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
